selectedFor: Two gabled wall dormers on the eaves sides of the main gable roof - one with a balcony on the front elevation (elewacja frontowa) and a stone-clad one on the garden elevation (elewacja ogrodowa); the dimensioned ground plan also prints 1950 x 958 (704+158+96) with a projecting bay and an attached garage.
A long four-window shed dormer on the front slope of the main roof, clearly drawn on the FRONT ELEVATION line drawing (39035ST_Front), next to a front-gabled garage wing that is a body in the plan.

A gabled wall dormer with a balcony on each eaves side, visible on "Elewacja przód" and "Elewacja tył"; the ground plan (Rzut parter) prints overall 16,82 x 10,12 m with a bay window and an attached garage inside the width.

The ground plan prints outer chains 1645 = 1305 + 340 (attached garage) and 1145 = 105 + 100 + 835 + 105, where the two 105 links are the open front and rear porches on posts and the garage wing is 100 shallower than the house.

The main-floor plan (22192SL_F1) prints overall 65'-4" x 49'-8" in feet-inches, where the depth runs from the back of the attached garage to the front edge of an open covered porch on posts; the REAR ELEVATION also shows a long shed dormer.

The dimensioned ground plan prints 1475 = 460 + 1015 and 1445 = 1070 + 375, the 375 being a flat-roofed garage block that projects in front of the hip-roofed house; the elevations show an open pergola on posts at the terrace and a flat entrance canopy on a post.

No dormer anywhere, but the front and rear elevations show roof windows and two ridge chimneys, both side elevations show a decorative timber lattice truss in a plain timber-clad gable end, and "Elewacja przód" shows a truss-filled gable over the projecting garage.

An open roofed porch on two stone posts under its own gable on BOTH eaves sides ("elewacja przód" and "elewacja tył"), with roof windows and chimneys on the plain gable roof and no dormer; the ground plan prints 1368 x 1268 = 165 + 938 + 165 with the porches inside the overall depth.
